relationships.subject: intravitreal anti-VEGF injection
relationships.evidence_quote: Our study supports these findings, indicating a marked increase in SBP from the pre-injection to during-injection time points.

key_findings: Most patients reported mild-to-moderate fear and maximal pain during intravitreal anti-VEGF injection, with higher pain in patients with fewer than 5 prior injections.
Systolic blood pressure rose during injection, more so in patients with fewer prior injections.
